meta.promptText: Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye konsa moisturizer kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Indian winters mein **rich, fragrance-free cream moisturizer** kharidein—gel nahi. Ingredients list mein **ceramides + glycerin/hyaluronic acid**, aur bahut dry skin ke liye **shea butter ya squalane** dekhein; ye skin barrier ko support karke moisture lock karte hain.[1][3]

**Achhe options:**
- **Normal-to-dry skin:** Cetaphil Moisturising Cream ya Venusia Max Cream  
- **Bahut dry/rough skin:** Bioderma Atoderm Creme ya Physiogel Daily Moisture Therapy Cream  
- **Sensitive skin:** Physiogel ya Cetaphil—fragrance-free variant  
- **Cracked areas/lips:** Raat mein moisturizer ke upar patli layer petroleum jelly lagayein.[3][5]

Moisturizer face wash ya bath ke **turant baad halki damp skin par**, din mein 2 baar lagayein.[3] Garam paani, harsh soap aur scrubs avoid karein. Agar redness, burning, severe itching ya cracks theek na hon, dermatologist ko dikhayein.
